posts: BridgePoint just crossed 169.7M canonical U.S. property records. The map is live: https://bridgepointintelligence.online/?utm_source=share_copy&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=canonical

Solo builder. Started on a phone. Roughly five months later: 169.7M canonical property records feeding a live 3D property-intelligence map. https://bridgepointintelligence.online/newsroom/solo-builder-proptech/
Investors in proptech/geospatial/insurtech: skip the pitch deck first. Inspect the live product. https://bridgepointintelligence.online/newsroom/investor-live-product-callout/

The same spatial backend is becoming a game. BridgePoint Horizon turns streamed terrain, roads, parcels and buildings into a playable survival world. Early access: https://bridgepointintelligence.online/app/horizon/early-access.html
Live storm intelligence is active now: 262 source-labelled hazard records are flowing into BridgePoint. https://bridgepointintelligence.online/newsroom/live-storm-intelligence/
